data.desc: Dyadic Applied BioSolutions is a global biotechnology company that aims to develop and commercialize scalable, non-animal protein production platforms to meet growing global demand across the life sciences, food and nutrition, and bio-industrial markets. These high-value proteins are designed to enable customers to develop more efficient, scalable and sustainable products. Dyadic's proprietary Dapibus and C1 expression systems support rapid, cost-effective and flexible manufacturing.
